13007-the-edda-volume-1-the-divine-mytho.title: The Divine Mythology of the North
13007-the-edda-volume-1-the-divine-mytho.creator: Winifred Faraday, M.A.
13007-the-edda-volume-1-the-divine-mytho.description: A book by Winifred Faraday, M.A.. This use of the word Edda is incorrect and unhistorical, though convenient and sanctioned by the use of several centuries. It was early used as a general term for the rules and materials for versemaking, and applied in this sense to Snorri's work.

arxiv-2101-08204.title: secureTF : A Secure TensorFlow Framework
arxiv-2101-08204.creator: Do Le Quoc, Franz Gregor, Sergei Arnautov, Roland Kunkel, Pramod Bhatotia, Christof Fetzer
arxiv-2101-08204.description: Abstract . Data-driven intelligent applications in modern online services have become ubiquitous. These applications are usually hosted in the untrusted cloud computing infrastructure. This poses significant security risks since these applications rely on applying machine learning algorithms on large datasets which may contain private and sensitive information.

arxiv-2103-09436.title: Semileptonic form factors of Ξ c → Ξ \Xi_{c}\to\Xi in QCD sum rules
arxiv-2103-09436.creator: Zhen-Xing Zhao 1 , Xiao-Yu Sun 1 , Fu-Wei Zhang 1 , Yi-Peng Xing 1 , Ya-Ting Yang 1
arxiv-2103-09436.description: Abstract There exists a significant deviation between the most recent Lattice QCD simulation and experimental measurement by Belle for Ξ c 0 → Ξ − ​ ℓ + ​ ν ℓ \Xi_{c}^{0}\to\Xi^{-}\ell^{+}\nu_{\ell} . In this work, we investigate the Ξ c → Ξ \Xi_{c}\to\Xi form factors in QCD sum rules.

arxiv-2302-07657.title: Dynamic Flows with Time-Dependent Capacities
arxiv-2302-07657.creator: Thomas Bläsius, Adrian Feilhauer, Jannik Westenfelder
arxiv-2302-07657.description: Abstract Dynamic network flows, sometimes called flows over time, extend the notion of network flows to include a transit time for each edge. While Ford and Fulkerson showed that certain dynamic flow problems can be solved via a reduction to static flows, many advanced models considering congestion and time-dependent networks result in NP-hard problems.

arxiv-2305-10409.title: Looking forward to photon-coupled long-lived particles II: dark axion portal
arxiv-2305-10409.creator: Krzysztof Jodłowski
arxiv-2305-10409.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Krzysztof Jodłowski. The dark axion portal is a dimension-5 coupling between an axion-like particle (ALP), a photon, and a dark photon, which is one of the targets of the intensity frontier searches looking for ∼ \sim\, sub-GeV long-lived particles (LLPs). In this work, we re-examine the limits set by existing detectors such as CHARM and NuCal, and by future experiments such as FASER2, MATHUSLA, and SHiP.

arxiv-2307-09221.title: Dirac Landau levels for surfaces with constant negative curvature
arxiv-2307-09221.creator: Maximilian Fürst 1, Denis Kochan 2,1,3, Ioachim-Gheorghe Dusa 1, Cosimo Gorini 4,1, Klaus Richter 1
arxiv-2307-09221.description: Abstract Studies of the formation of Landau levels based on the Schrödinger equation for electrons constrained to curved surfaces have a long history. These include as prime examples surfaces with constant positive and negative curvature, the sphere Haldane 1983 and the pseudosphere Comtet 1987 .

arxiv-2308-16712.title: Implementing scalable matrix-vector products for the exact diagonalization methods in quantum many-body physics Conference: The 6th Annual Parallel Applications Workshop, Alternatives To MPI+X; November 13, 2023; Denver, CO
arxiv-2308-16712.creator: Tom Westerhout, Bradford L. Chamberlain
arxiv-2308-16712.description: Abstract . Exact diagonalization is a well-established method for simulating small quantum systems. Its applicability is limited by the exponential growth of the so-called Hamiltonian matrix that needs to be diagonalized. Physical symmetries are usually utilized to reduce the matrix dimension, and distributed-memory parallelism is employed to explore larger systems.

arxiv-2309-04321.title: Composite scalar bosons masses: Effective potential versus Bethe-Salpeter approach
arxiv-2309-04321.creator: A. Doff
arxiv-2309-04321.description: Abstract Ten years ago the 125 125 GeV Higgs resonance was discovered at the LHC atlas ; cms , if this boson is a fundamental particle or a particle composed of new strongly interacting particles is still an open question.

arxiv-2312-09142.title: Comments on ”Necessary optimality conditions of an optimization problem governed by a double phase PDE”
arxiv-2312-09142.description: Abstract Omar Benslimane and Nazih Abderrazzak Gadhi 1 1 1 LAMA, FSDM, Sidi Mohamed Ben Abdellah University, Fes, Morocco. Emails: abderrazzak.gadhinazih@usmba.ac.ma , obenslimane22@gmail.com Abstract. This note concerns the paper by Benslimane et Gadhi (JMAA. doi: 10.1016/j.jmaa.2023.127117) where the authors established necessary optimality conditions for an optimization problem \left(\mathcal{P}\right) governed by a double phase partial differential equation \left(\mathcal{P}_{f}\right).

arxiv-2406-02257.title: Intrinsic spin Hall effect from spin quantum metric
arxiv-2406-02257.creator: Longjun Xiang, Hao Jin, Jian Wang
arxiv-2406-02257.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Longjun Xiang, Hao Jin, Jian Wang. The intrinsic spin Hall effect (ISHE), as proposed in [ Phys. 92 , 126603 (2004) ], stems from the spin Berry curvature. Herein, we propose the concept of spin quantum metric , which is established as the quantum geometric counterpart of the spin Berry curvature within the spin quantum geometric tensor , defined in a manner analogous to the conventional quantum geometric tensor.

arxiv-2410-16631.title: Benchmarking Multi-Scene Fire and Smoke Detection
arxiv-2410-16631.creator: Xiaoyi Han, Nan Pu, Zunlei Feng, Yijun Bei, Qifei Zhang, Lechao Cheng, Liang Xue
arxiv-2410-16631.description: Abstract The current irregularities in existing public Fire and Smoke Detection (FSD) datasets have become a bottleneck in the advancement of FSD technology. Upon in-depth analysis, we identify the core issue as the lack of standardized dataset construction, uniform evaluation systems, and clear performance benchmarks.

arxiv-2504-19489.title: How Cohesive Are Community Search Results on Online Social Networks?: An Experimental Evaluation
arxiv-2504-19489.creator: Yining Zhao, Sourav S Bhowmick, Nastassja L. Fischer, SH Annabel Chen
arxiv-2504-19489.description: Abstract . Recently, numerous community search methods for large graphs have been proposed, at the core of which is defining and measuring cohesion . This paper experimentally evaluates the effectiveness of these community search algorithms w.r.t. cohesiveness in the context of online social networks.

arxiv-2508-12004.title: A Parameterized Perspective on Uniquely Restricted Matchings
arxiv-2508-12004.creator: Juhi Chaudhary, Ignasi Sau, Meirav Zehavi
arxiv-2508-12004.description: Abstract Given a graph G G , a matching is a subset of edges of G G that do not share an endpoint. A matching M M is uniquely restricted if the subgraph induced by the endpoints of the edges of M M has exactly one perfect matching.

arxiv-2512-10964.title: Tekum: Balanced Ternary Tapered Precision Real Arithmetic
arxiv-2512-10964.creator: Laslo Hunhold
arxiv-2512-10964.description: Abstract In light of recent hardware advances, it is striking that real arithmetic in balanced ternary logic has received almost no attention in the literature. This is particularly surprising given ternary logic’s promising properties, which could open new avenues for energy-efficient computing and offer novel strategies for overcoming the memory wall.

arxiv-2602-15138.title: MB-DSMIL-CL-PL: Scalable Weakly Supervised Ovarian Cancer Subtype Classification and Localisation Using Contrastive and Prototype Learning with Frozen Patch Features
arxiv-2602-15138.creator: Marcus Jenkins, Jasenka Mazibrada, Bogdan Leahu, Michal Mackiewicz
arxiv-2602-15138.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Marcus Jenkins, Jasenka Mazibrada, Bogdan Leahu, Michal Mackiewicz. The study of histopathological subtypes is valuable for the personalisation of effective treatment strategies for ovarian cancer. However, increasing diagnostic workloads present a challenge for UK pathology departments, leading to the rise in AI approaches. While traditional approaches in this field have relied on pre-computed, frozen image features, recent advances have shifted towards end-to-end feature extraction, providing an improvement in accuracy but at the expense of significantly reduced scalability during training and time-consuming experimentation.

doe-osti-3364916-resstock-measure-docume.creator: Liu, Lixi, Maguire, Jeff, Lou, Yingli
doe-osti-3364916-resstock-measure-docume.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. This report is part of a series describing different ResStock measures. "Measures" refers to energy efficiency retrofits that can be applied to buildings during modeling. This documentation covers the “Heat Pump Water Heater” measure upgrade methodology and briefly discusses key

pmc-11371617.title: Efficient use of binned data for imputing univariate time series data
pmc-11371617.creator: Jay Darji, Nupur Biswas, Vijay Padul, Jaya Gill, Santosh Kesari, Shashaanka Ashili
pmc-11371617.description: Time series data are recorded in various sectors, resulting in a large amount of data. However, the continuity of these data is often interrupted, resulting in periods of missing data. Several algorithms are used to impute the missing data, and the performance of these methods is widely varied.

pmc-11596771.title: CMV Infection Risk Factors and Viral Dynamics After Valganciclovir Prophylaxis: 10 Years of Experience in Lung Transplant Recipients
pmc-11596771.creator: Sarela García-Masedo Fernández, Rosalía Laporta, Christian García Fadul, Myriam Aguilar Pérez, Jorge Anel Pedroche, Raquel Sanabrias Fernández de Sevilla, Ana Royuela, Isabel Sánchez Romero, María Piedad Ussetti Gil, Antonella d’Arminio Monforte
pmc-11596771.description: (1) The prevention of cytomegalovirus (CMV) in lung transplant recipients (LTx) is based on the administration of VGC for a period of 6–12 months, but there is little information on the premature discontinuation of the drug. Our objective was to evaluate the reasons for early cessation of VGC and the dynamics of CMV replication after discontinuation.

pmc-12534178.title: Fiber-coupled broadband quantum memory for polarization-encoded photonic qubits
pmc-12534178.creator: Sandra Cheng, Carson Evans, Todd Pittman
pmc-12534178.description: Various near-term quantum networking applications will benefit from low-loss, fiber-coupled photonic quantum memory devices with high efficiencies. We demonstrate a fiber-coupled loop-and-switch quantum memory platform with a pass-through efficiency of ~54% and an overall storage efficiency that scales as ~0.5N+1 where N is the number of storage cycles.

pmc-12735834.title: Novel Trinorditerpene from Dysoxylum parasiticum (Osbeck) Kosterm: Leaf Extract with Cytotoxic, Antioxidant and α-Glucosidase Inhibitory Activities
pmc-12735834.creator: I Putu Agus Hendra Wibawa, Faris Hermawan, Minarti, Puspa Dewi Lotulung, Nina Artanti, Muhammad Hanafi, Vito M Butardo, Peter J Mahon, David Barker, Arjun H Banskota, Agnieszka Kicel
pmc-12735834.description: Natural products derived from plants have been extensively developed as alternative medicines due to their relatively minimal side effects. Here we present the purification and characteristics of parasitic acid, a novel trinorditerpene from Dysoxylum parasiticum leaf extract, and investigate various bioactivities.

pmc-13018963.title: No excess risk of death or multimorbidity following hemorrhagic stroke after mRNA vaccination compared with historical cases: a population-based cohort study
pmc-13018963.creator: Song Song, Yuqi Hu, Wenxin Tian, Cuiling Wei, Xinya Mu, Rachel Yui Ki Chu, Qi Sun, Yifang Huang, Zijie Xu, Wenlong Liu, Lingyue Zhou, Boyan Liu, Ian Chi Kei Wong, Francisco Tsz Tsun Lai
pmc-13018963.description: IntroductionWhile the association between hemorrhagic stroke and prior COVID-19 mRNA vaccination remains inconclusive, an examination of its prognosis may generate evidence on the potential causality of this relationship. If a causal link does exist, transient vaccine-related mechanisms (e.g., thrombocytopenia) might lead to a more favorable prognosis than naturally acquired cases.

pmc-13065857.title: The Association Between Power of Food Scale Scores and Weight Among Black/African American Individuals Consuming a Vegan or Low‐Fat Omnivorous Diet in a Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13065857.creator: Alexis Bell, John A. Bernhart, Yesil Kim, Enid A. Keseko, Gabrielle Turner-McGrievy
pmc-13065857.description: The NEW Soul study was a 2‐year, 2‐group randomized controlled trial intervention in South Carolina comparing the effects of a vegan (plant based) diet to those of a low‐fat (< 30%) omnivorous diet among African American adults, ages 18–65 years old, and with overweight or obesity.

pmc-13198713.title: Refractory pancreatic fistula following distal pancreatectomy successfully treated with N-butyl-2-cyanoacrylate and vascular embolization coils using a pull-through technique
pmc-13198713.creator: Takumi Hamada, You Kamiizumi, Reimi Kawagoe, Ryo Kanazawa, Takeshi Tsuji, Yasuhiro Tani, Tomoaki Kawai, Tsutomu Haneda, Akinobu Taketomi
pmc-13198713.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Postoperative pancreatic fistula (PF) remains a serious complication after distal pancreatectomy (DP), particularly when it is refractory to standard management. Herein, we report a case of refractory Grade C PF following DP for pancreatic adenosquamous carcinoma. Despite conservative treatment, repeated image-guided percutaneous drainage, and endoscopic pancreatic duct stenting, the fistula persisted and was complicated by gastroduodenal artery bleeding and duodenal perforation. Given the patient’s early postoperative recurrence, poor prognosis, and high surgical risk, further surgical intervention was considered inappropriate.

pmc-13219218.title: Coded Taxonomy Applied to Old and New Descriptions of Mucrosomia (Collembola: Isotomidae): A Bibliographic Revision and New Species of the Genus
pmc-13219218.creator: Estevam Cipriano Araujo de Lima, Aila Soares Ferreira, Misael Augusto de Oliveira-Neto, Bruna Carolline Honório Lopes, Nathan Paiva Brito, Roniere Andrade de Brito, Douglas Zeppelini
pmc-13219218.description: Collembola are minute, wingless hexapods that occur in nearly all terrestrial ecosystems and playing a fundamental role in soil functioning and global carbon cycling. The taxonomy within the family Isotomidae is unclear due to the strong morphological similarity among species, low interspecific variability, and overlapping chaetotaxic patterns that often obscure species boundaries.

pmc-13272565.title: A culturomics biobank decodes extremophile evolution and metabolism in acid mine drainage
pmc-13272565.creator: Xiu-Tong Li, Xuan Zhang, Zong-Lin Liang, Zhen Jiang, Ye Huang, Yu-Qian Han, Ze-Bao Tan, Ying-Liu, Zheng-Hua Liu, Hua-qun Yin, Shuang-Jiang Liu, Cheng-Ying Jiang
pmc-13272565.description: Extreme environments such as acid mine drainage (AMD) host highly specialized microbial communities that drive profound biogeochemical cycles. Within these ecosystems, iron- and sulfur-metabolizing taxa catalyze mineral weathering, generating intense acidity and mobilizing heavy metals. However, more than 97% of these microorganisms remain uncultured "microbial dark matter," heavily restricting our understanding of extremophile metabolism and adaptation.

pmc-13328459.title: Assessing calibration methods for fenuron determination in carrot juice via GC–MS with salt-assisted switchable solvent microextraction
pmc-13328459.creator: Süleyman Bodur, Sezin Erarpat Bodur, Sude Oflu, Ömer Tahir Günkara, Sezgin Bakırdere
pmc-13328459.description: An accurate and precise analytical method was established for the determination of fenuron in carrot juice samples. Salt-assisted switchable solvent-liquid phase microextraction (SA-SS-LPME) was performed to achieve a lower detection limit. Three different calibration methods were compared to quadruple isotope dilution (ID4) in terms of accuracy and precision.

pmc-13364891.title: Community-engaged and Implementation Science-informed Pediatric Sleep Intervention Research
pmc-13364891.creator: Ariel A Williamson, Jessica C Levenson
pmc-13364891.description: Purpose of ReviewCommunity-engaged research (CEnR) and implementation science can address gaps in translating evidence-based interventions to real-world practice by considering the needs of patients/families, clinicians, and contexts. This review summarizes recent pediatric sleep intervention research that incorporates CEnR and/or implementation science principles. We also identify key areas for future research.

pmc-13454097.title: Designing Efficient Inverted Perovskite Solar Cells with Self-Assembled Monolayer Hole Transport Layers
pmc-13454097.creator: Xinyuan Feng, Qiuying Su, Long Zhou, Jiaojiao Zhang, Dazheng Chen, Weidong Zhu, He Xi, Chunfu Zhang, Jincheng Zhang, Yue Hao
pmc-13454097.description: Highlights This review summarizes the development of self-assembled monolayers (SAMs), with a special focus on their applications in inverted (p-i-n) perovskite solar cells.This review discusses the structure, preparation methods, interfacial roles of SAMs, as well as the common problems encountered during their fabrication process.

pmc-13598638.title: Clinical Evidence and Mechanistic Plausibility of Chinese Patent Medicines for Sepsis: An Evidence Map
pmc-13598638.creator: Qingsong Liu, Mengyao Zheng, Zichen Wang, Yifei He, Jiayue Xu, Wen Wang, Xin Sun
pmc-13598638.description: Sepsis is a life-threatening syndrome with limited specific therapeutic options. Chinese patent medicines (CPMs) are widely used as adjunctive therapies in China, although the available clinical evidence, predominantly from injectable formulations, remains fragmented. This evidence map integrated review-level clinical evidence with in vivo findings to assess evidence certainty and mechanistic plausibility.

pmc-13662586.title: Molecular mechanisms of the hypothalamus miR-27a/PRKCA pathway in regulating neuronal function and aggression-related behavior
pmc-13662586.creator: Xiao-Huan Chao, Chun-Lei Zhang, Huan Yang, Qing-Lei Xu, Ming-Zheng Liu, Jia-Hao Chen, Shu-Han Liu, Zi-Ming Wang, Yuan Ding, Hong-Wei Bi, Wen Guo, Jun-Hong Fan, Meng-Jun Zhou, Jian-Sheng Ma, Asim Muhammad, Mubashir Muhammad, Bo Zhou
pmc-13662586.description: The intensification of livestock production has heightened public concern about animal welfare, with aggressive behavior recognized as a key determinant of both welfare and productivity. MicroRNAs (miRNAs), which are critical post-transcriptional regulators, have emerged as important modulators of animal behavior. This study investigated the molecular basis of aggression in pigs (Sus scrofa), focusing on miRNA-mediated regulation.
